mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 52 degrees under clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail, and the moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase.
The City of Verona is moving forward with several development projects, including site plans for 201 South Main Street and ongoing reviews for the Sub-Zero facility at Liberty Business Park.

Today is packed with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown Farmer's Market, or Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police update, on September 21, an individual was identified and cited for retail theft after taking Swedish Fish from a business located in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so please plan your visit accordingly to enjoy this sweet daily special.
